quote.text: ..itaque cum legere non possis quantum habueris, satis est habere quantum legas
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Sometimes, as parents, we feel the pressure to know and do everything for our children; similarly, with learning, it's enough to embrace the knowledge we do acquire rather than lamenting what we haven't.
    • Accept that each conversation, story, or lesson shared with your child is a valuable learning moment, reminding us to appreciate quality over quantity in our everyday actions.
  • Leadership
    • A leader understands that progress comes not from the sheer volume of information consumed, but from the depth of insight gathered and applied in decisions.
    • This perspective encourages leaders to value every piece of wisdom—as each contributes to truth and strength—even when complete knowledge remains elusive.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, it is important to focus on actionable insights rather than chasing an endless list of features or data points; quality reads and well-considered decisions lead to better outcomes.
    • Embracing this mindset fosters a practice of continuous improvement, where each small piece of knowledge contributes to overall growth and innovation in the product journey.
